coverage: Real registry/tokens SQL services, two repositories and four credential states.
SQL capture/import into a fresh Durable Object followed by actual eviction.
Read/write scopes, revoked/expired rejection, wrong-repository rejection.
Repository identity, metadata and pending-fork state preserved.
Backup pages exclude generated plaintext credentials.
A new revocation survives another eviction without affecting the source.
limits: No deployed account, authenticated coordinator or production writer barrier.
Tests SQL state, not namespace HTTP authorization or fork object resolution.
Credentials are local-only dummy values held by the test; no real credentials exported.
